journeys.title: First use, authentication, context, and project creation

sourceSteps.result: Exact P1 result is operationRef=media.operation-slice.create-project, outcome, observedAt, and outputs; a successful versioned-project-state receipt carries opaque projectId and initialRevisionId for the atomically created ACTIVE project and empty immutable COMMITTED initial revision whose ID is the project head.

p1OperationResultBindings.exactResult: A time-scoped authorized project summary page; an empty page is scoped to the selected workspace and observedAt, not global absence.
p1OperationResultBindings.unknownDisposition: The result schema distinguishes UNKNOWN_OBSERVATION from OBSERVED; preserve that distinction and do not infer a cross-workspace inventory.
p1OperationResultBindings.errorsAndRecovery: Reobserve only the same authorized tenant, principal, workspace, and query; no command replay.

p1OperationResultBindings.exactResult: P1 result fields are operationRef, outcome, observedAt, and outputs; the successful versioned-project-state receipt carries projectId and initialRevisionId for the atomic ACTIVE project and empty immutable COMMITTED initial revision.
p1OperationResultBindings.finality: Only the atomic authoritative commit receipt establishes project creation; HTTP acknowledgment or local dispatch alone is not finality.
p1OperationResultBindings.unknownDisposition: After dispatch without an authoritative commit receipt, preserve UNKNOWN_OUTCOME and the original requestId.
p1OperationResultBindings.errorsAndRecovery: Inspect using the same requestId and original request fingerprint before any resubmission; never blindly retry an ambiguous dispatch.

p1OperationResultBindings.exactResult: A time-scoped observation of the selected project and exact current head revision, or same-request creation reconciliation.
p1OperationResultBindings.finality: Observation only; the returned head is current as of observedAt and is not a write precondition or rights proof.
p1OperationResultBindings.unknownDisposition: If reconciliation cannot establish the original creation receipt and initialRevisionId, preserve UNKNOWN_OUTCOME.
p1OperationResultBindings.errorsAndRecovery: Reobserve the same selector under current authority; never create or replay from an unavailable or scoped-absence result.

journeys.title: Upload or import, inspect, and verify a usable artifact

p1OperationResultBindings.exactResult: The typed result is an upload-session receipt; upload completion and artifact verification remain separate operations.
p1OperationResultBindings.finality: Successful response establishes only an upload-session receipt; upload completion and artifact verification are separate.
p1OperationResultBindings.unknownDisposition: Preserve UNKNOWN_OUTCOME and reconcile the same tenant, principal, and idempotency key before using any new upload identity.
p1OperationResultBindings.errorsAndRecovery: Reconcile the same identity before any new upload; no automatic retry is defined.

p1OperationResultBindings.exactResult: The typed result reports an upload-session receipt with observed bytesReceived, nextChunkIndex, and status; it does not establish complete bytes or artifact availability.
p1OperationResultBindings.finality: Updated upload-session receipt only; complete bytes and artifact availability are not established.
p1OperationResultBindings.unknownDisposition: Preserve UNKNOWN_OUTCOME and inspect the same upload before another command; never automatically replay.
p1OperationResultBindings.errorsAndRecovery: Inspect the same upload identity before another command; no automatic replay.

p1OperationResultBindings.exactResult: The typed result is a checksum-verified artifact receipt with opaque storage reference; it does not establish downstream job use, rights clearance, or delivery.
p1OperationResultBindings.finality: Returned artifact receipt only; downstream use, rights clearance, and delivery are not established.
p1OperationResultBindings.unknownDisposition: Preserve UNKNOWN_OUTCOME and inspect the same upload and artifact identities; do not infer availability or create another artifact.
p1OperationResultBindings.errorsAndRecovery: Reconcile the same upload and artifact identities; no second artifact creation or inferred availability.

p1OperationResultBindings.exactResult: The typed result is a time-scoped upload-session observation, not an artifact or completion proof.
p1OperationResultBindings.finality: Read-only upload-session observation; it is not artifact or completion proof.
p1OperationResultBindings.unknownDisposition: An unavailable read does not prove global absence or safe replay.
p1OperationResultBindings.errorsAndRecovery: Repeat only the same scoped read; a read result never authorizes command replay.

p1OperationResultBindings.exactResult: The scoped read envelope contains typed observations and observedAt; it does not define job status dimensions or imply a state transition.
p1OperationResultBindings.finality: Read-only observation; it establishes no state mutation, external effect, or authorization grant.
p1OperationResultBindings.unknownDisposition: Preserve unavailable or scoped-absence results as unknown; do not infer job, attempt, or processing completion.
p1OperationResultBindings.errorsAndRecovery: Reobserve with the same selector; never replay a command based on a query result.

p1OperationResultBindings.exactResult: The typed read returns metadata and recorded integrity/lifecycle disposition for the exact immutable artifact version, with observedAt; content bytes are not returned.
p1OperationResultBindings.finality: Read-only observation; it does not establish current availability, rights, permission to process, or external effect.
p1OperationResultBindings.unknownDisposition: Preserve UNKNOWN_OUTCOME and caller-scoped absence; neither proves global nonexistence or current availability.
p1OperationResultBindings.errorsAndRecovery: Reobserve only the same exact artifact/version under current read authority; no command replay.

journeys.title: Transcribe an audio recording and correct captions

sourceSteps.result: Immediate result is limited to the exact P1 query result schema fields requestId, exactTargetRef, ownerReceipt, and observedAt. Job progress and finality remain UNKNOWN because the selected observer contract does not bind those fields; no transcript or caption finality or completion is inferred.

p1OperationResultBindings.exactResult: Stable logical job identity and submission receipt only; no job/attempt status or recognition completion.
p1OperationResultBindings.finality: Submission receipt is not completion, transcript availability, or approval.
p1OperationResultBindings.errorsAndRecovery: Preserve exact request identity. Explicit rejection follows its typed error; UNKNOWN_OUTCOME reconciles that same request and forbids replay until resolved.

p1OperationResultBindings.exactResult: Scoped query envelope only (requestId, exactTargetRef, ownerReceipt, observedAt); no job, attempt, or transcription-completion observation is defined.
p1OperationResultBindings.finality: Progress and completion remain UNKNOWN; never derive transcript/caption finality from the query receipt.
p1OperationResultBindings.errorsAndRecovery: Missing, denied, stale, mismatched, or unavailable scoped observation remains UNKNOWN; retry only as the same authorized read, never as a submission.

p1OperationResultBindings.exactSelector: One exact transcriptVersionId; sourceArtifactId and sourceArtifactVersionId resolve from that immutable version in caller scope.
p1OperationResultBindings.exactResult: Same transcriptVersionId and source pair, per-field availability, supplied transcript/source observations, and observedAt.
p1OperationResultBindings.errorsAndRecovery: INVALID_REQUEST, ACCESS_DENIED, TRANSCRIPT_VERSION_NOT_FOUND_IN_CALLER_SCOPE, SOURCE_IDENTITY_MISMATCH, or UNAVAILABLE remain typed; re-read only the same exact version under current authority, never substitute job state or latest.

p1OperationResultBindings.exactResult: Session-local draft identity/revision remains linked to the exact source version and typed parent; text correction alone does not register an immutable caption.
p1OperationResultBindings.errorsAndRecovery: Preserve source, parent, and edit on conflict; explicit rebase is required. Unknown write outcome reconciles the same request and fingerprint.

p1OperationResultBindings.exactResult: Session-local timing draft identity/revision remains linked to the exact source version and typed parent; timing correction alone does not register an immutable caption.
p1OperationResultBindings.errorsAndRecovery: Preserve source, parent, and edit on conflict; explicit rebase is required. Unknown write outcome reconciles the same request and fingerprint.

p1OperationResultBindings.exactResult: Durable receipt identifies the exact new immutable captionVersionId, source version, and parent; registration alone grants no approval or publication.
p1OperationResultBindings.errorsAndRecovery: Preserve append-only semantics and exact request identity; UNKNOWN_OUTCOME reconciles the same request/fingerprint, never creates a second version by inference.

p1OperationResultBindings.exactResult: Read-only exact caption-version or exact version-pair comparison; no merge, mutation, approval, or publication.
p1OperationResultBindings.errorsAndRecovery: Preserve the exact selector/pair; missing or non-current evidence stays UNKNOWN, with same-request reconciliation where applicable.
